high_level_description: This image depicts an old, weathered building with a somewhat dilapidated appearance. The structure is made of light-colored stone or concrete, showing signs of age and wear, such as peeling paint and discoloration on the facade. There are two prominent red brick chimneys on either side of the building, adding a contrasting color to the otherwise muted tones of the stone. The windows are rectangular and appear to be double-hung, with some showing signs of damage or disrepair.
